title: Lesson 1 — Introduction to Penetration Testing
summary: What penetration testing is, how it differs from a QA bug hunt, the methodology behind every engagement, the law and ethics that keep it legal, and your first safe scan from a Mac.

title: Lesson 2 — Building Your macOS Pentesting Lab
summary: Turn your Mac into a safe, legal practice range: a Kali Linux VM under UTM as the attack box, a deliberately vulnerable target in Docker, the networking that joins them, and the snapshot habits that keep it repeatable.

title: Lesson 3 — Networking Foundations for Pentesters
summary: The terrain every attack crosses: IP addresses and subnets, ports and sockets, the TCP three-way handshake, UDP and DNS — then watch a real handshake in your lab and see what Nmap's scan types are actually doing.
